sets.title: Out of Life
sets.place: Window Frame Tower, Hometown Skyline (HOME district, Baltimere)
sets.kind: high-rise apartment bedroom with an iron fire escape outside the window

sets.situation: In a plain, dim high-rise bedroom the POET (black t-shirt) reads the poem aloud to the EX, who sits outside on the fire escape, back to him, vaping, while a TV cycles images of the world's chaos. Vape haze fills the room inside and out; he moves toward the window but the EX recedes, then falls off the fire escape into darkness and he falls after through clouds into black. Mid-fall (title card) he crashes into an old-time vintage party, chases the EX through the slow-motion crowd but the EX keeps vanishing, then trips through a hole in the floor into pure blackness.

sets.title: How to Break off an Engagement
sets.place: The Abandoned Temple (Break Engagement node, Center zone)
sets.kind: derelict seaside chapel on an eroding shore
sets.analog: a storm-eaten island chapel in the Chesapeake Bay, like the lost church and graves of Holland Island, Maryland, swallowed by the water
sets.situation: No people: the tambourine thrown in Flashing Lights tumbles through black space and flies, still whole, through a chapel window. In time-lapse the empty chapel decays - choir stands, prayer lines, baptism pools, cobwebbed pews, gift boxes left outside the side doors - until a heavy storm takes over and speeds the decay. When the storm ends only remnants of the chapel are left on the shore, and the tambourine finally lands on them and shatters.

sets.situation: Decades later the POET hosts friends and events in the new temple; archival photos of his circle are reenacted there. The guests are his brothers and friends, laughing, hugging and shouting, then spilling outside to the trees, a meadow and finally a porch light. The EX is absent. sets.title: How to Win My Heart

His wishes and losses play as cutaways (a couple at water on Jupiter's moon, an old couple praying in church, flower fields harvested into his power). He keeps watching from a distant window, then stands and walks the harbor as haze rises off the water.
